summary: Iteration 6 — Verified (1) BUG FIX PDF/image preview via blob (axios responseType=blob, iframe/img with blob: URL) — real PDF '00205055 Balonlu.pdf' on PRÇ-2026-058 renders inside data-testid=file-preview-pdf as blob-URL <iframe> (no 401, no blank). (2) BUG FIX stale preview — useEffect on part.id resets preview state; verified twice: after closing preview+modal on Part A and opening Part B, drawing-preview-overlay is NOT visible; even when the overlay was closed via X and modal via Escape and a new part opened, no stale overlay. (3) NEW FEATURE order_no — POST/PUT/GET /api/parts accept & persist order_no (default ''); input-order-no in form; PartCard shows 'Sip: <order_no>'; PartDetailModal header shows 'Sip: <order_no> · <part_code>' + Sipariş No spec; dashboard search-input matches order_no. (4) Excel export includes 'Sipariş No' as column A with value. (5) Regression: GET /api/files/{path} still authorizes via cookie, Bearer, and ?auth query (401 without any). All 9 pytest tests pass; all critical UI flows pass.

No action needed if PartDetailModal now delegates to FilePreview (it does).
critical_code_review_comments: FilePreview.jsx blob approach is correct: uses api axios instance (withCredentials + Bearer fallback), revokes object URL on unmount/change. Good.
PartDetailModal useEffect on [part?.id] correctly resets preview + note on part switch — bug fix 2 verified.
Backend PartCreate.order_no defaults to '' (not None) — consistent with Part model. Good serialization behavior.
Excel export uses d.get('order_no','') so parts created before the migration still export as blank Sipariş No — safe.
